name: Passport
definition: booklet issued by a state to identify its holder for international travel; ICAO codes (PP, PE, PD, PO, PR, PT, PS, PL, PM) and issuer designs are named forms.
notes: PRADO category A passports incl. Luxembourg laissez-passer (temporary); US 1934 passport sold.

name: National identity card
definition: card issued by a state to prove the holder's identity and citizenship or residence (Jumindeungrokjeung, Nafnskírteini, CURP card, Carteira Nacional de Identificação as named forms; My Number card and Personalausweis named forms †).
notes: PRADO category B identity card; paper Ausweis ID cards sold.

name: Driving licence
definition: document issued to permit its holder to drive; licence categories are a C17 entry, issuer designs named forms.

name: Residence permit
definition: document issued to a non-citizen to prove the right to reside (Taiwan's Alien Resident Certificate as a named form).

name: Visa
definition: label, stamp or sheet issued to permit entry to or stay in a country; visa types are a C17 entry.
notes: PRADO category C visa is a sticker, 105 x 74 mm.

name: Birth certificate
definition: certificate recording a person's birth.

name: Marriage certificate
definition: certificate recording a marriage (ketubah a named form †; F2 when made as a picture).

name: Death certificate
definition: certificate recording a person's death.

name: Divorce papers
definition: decree or certificate recording the dissolution of a marriage.

name: Baptism certificate
definition: certificate recording a baptism or christening (F2 when made as a picture, K-112).
notes: Sold as filled and blank certificates; Taufschein is German-American design.

name: Vaccination certificate
definition: paper record or card certifying vaccinations received (F-22; H2 holds only devices and supplies).
notes: Sold as International Certificate of Vaccination yellow card (carte jaune), new stock.

name: Deed
definition: document that conveys or proves title to property (the land itself is G2).

name: Will
definition: document setting out how a person's estate is to be disposed of after death.

name: Promissory note
definition: signed written promise to pay a sum to a named party.

name: Share certificate
definition: printed certificate of ownership of shares in a company (F5, not F3, K-27).

name: Bond certificate
definition: printed certificate of a bond or debt owed by its issuer.

name: Cheque
definition: printed order to a bank to pay a sum, kept as an object (K-27).

name: Traveller's cheque
definition: pre-paid cheque in a fixed amount for travellers, kept as an object (K-27).
notes: Auction lot of American Express travelers cheque; sold as salvage collectible.

name: Postal order
definition: money order issued by a post office, kept as an object (K-27).
notes: Unused US postal money order listed for collectors.

name: Tax paper (return, assessment)
definition: paper tax return or assessment notice kept as a record (F-22).

name: Diploma
definition: document issued by a school or university to certify a degree or completed course.

name: Certificate (of achievement, training or membership)
definition: document certifying an achievement, a qualification or membership of a body.

name: School report
definition: report issued by a school on a pupil's progress (F-22).

name: Identity badge
definition: badge or card bearing the holder's name or photograph, carried to show who the holder is (a door-opening function is an attribute, P5).

name: Access badge
definition: badge or pass bearing the holder's name or photograph, carried to show what site or event the holder may enter.

name: Crew member certificate
definition: identity document issued to airline crew under the ICAO and ISO/IEC 7810 formats.
notes: Airline air crew member certificate, El Al 1961.

name: Credit card
definition: card that draws on a line of credit from its issuer.

name: Debit card
definition: card that draws directly on the holder's bank account.

name: Charge card
definition: card whose balance must be paid in full each period.

name: ATM card
definition: card that gives access to a bank account at cash machines only.

name: Gift card
definition: card holding a prepaid value redeemable for goods or services (`acceptance` closed-system or semi-closed is an attribute).

name: Gift certificate
definition: paper voucher or gift token redeemable only with its issuer (circulating scrip is F3).

name: Telephone card
definition: prepaid card for public telephones (`technology` optical, chip or magnetic is an attribute).

name: Transit farecard
definition: stored-value or pass card for public transport fares (Suica, Octopus, EZ-Link, China T-Union, SUBE, Beep, Washington Metro farecard as maker-bound named forms tied to C13 rows).

name: Membership card
definition: card issued to show the holder's membership of a club or body.
notes: Club membership cards sold; London Museum record is not a sale.

name: Loyalty card
definition: card issued by a retailer to collect discounts or points.

name: Key card
definition: card that opens a lock and names no holder (a hotel key card, P5).
notes: Hotel keycards collected; key fobs sold; Colnect lists Hotel Cards.

name: SIM card
definition: physical subscriber identity module card for a mobile network (an eSIM profile is part of its I3 plan, K-28).

name: Letter
definition: written or typed message sent or kept on paper, signed letters included (`document_class`).

name: Diary or journal
definition: written personal diary or journal.

name: Kept greeting card (written in)
definition: greeting card that has been written in and kept (a blank one is C5).

name: Filled notebook
definition: notebook that has been written in and kept (a blank one is C5).
notes: Only a commonplace-book manuscript listing seen; partial.

name: House plans
definition: drawn or printed plans of a dwelling kept as a record.

name: Postally used cover
definition: envelope that passed through the post, neither administration-issued nor a first-day cover (K-118).

name: Photographic print
definition: photograph printed on paper or card (carte de visite, cabinet card, real photo postcard, snapshot as named forms).

name: Slide
definition: developed transparency mounted for projection or viewing.

name: Negative (developed)
definition: developed photographic negative on film or plate.

name: Home film reel
definition: film shot by the owner or family on a reel (8 mm, Super 8, 16 mm).

name: Home videotape
definition: videotape recorded by the owner or family.

name: Photo album (filled)
definition: album holding photographic prints.

name: Scrapbook (filled)
definition: album filled with kept papers of every kind (a blank scrapbook album is C4).

name: Picture postcard
definition: printed picture postcard, used or not (`postcard_era` and `print_process` are attributes; a real photo postcard is F5.3.2.01).

name: Ticket stub
definition: used ticket kept after the event or journey.

name: Programme
definition: printed programme of a performance or event, kept.

name: Autograph
definition: signature collected on a card or page (`document_class` cut signature, SP and the like).

name: Menu
definition: printed menu of a restaurant, banquet or voyage, kept.

name: Invitation
definition: printed invitation to an event, kept.

name: Advertising trade card
definition: card issued by a business to advertise it (a card issued in a numbered series to be collected is F3).

name: Printed advertisement or handbill
definition: single printed advertising item kept after use (handbill, flyer, leaflet, a detached magazine or newspaper advertisement page); a large public notice is a broadside, a poster F2, a catalogue or booklet F1 (section 14; a named form of broadside if not attested as its own category).
notes: Sold singly as trade handbill and inside broadside categories; not found as own category.

name: Business card
definition: printed card giving a person's or firm's name and contact details.

name: Receipt (billheads included)
definition: printed or written receipt or billhead, kept.

name: Label
definition: printed product or trade label, kept.

name: Broadside
definition: large single printed sheet issued as a public notice or announcement.

name: Bookplate
definition: printed label pasted in a book to mark its owner (level provisional).
notes: Dedicated bookplate sites; societies sell bookplates as own category.

name: Timetable
definition: printed timetable of a transport service, kept (level provisional).
notes: eBay has own category: Railroad Public Timetables.

name: Bookmark
definition: printed or card bookmark, kept as ephemera (level provisional).
notes: Silk Stevens bookmarks sold; Colnect lists Bookmarks as catalogue.
